blocks.text: In synthesis the target molecule is prepared from simple, commercially available compounds, sometimes in many steps. For example, a primary aliphatic amine can be made in one step by treating a halogenoalkane with ammonia: R-CH2-Cl + NH3 -> R-CH2-NH2 + HCl. Halogenoalkanes are not easily available, but they are made from alcohols, which are, so the amine can be made in two steps from an alcohol: R-CH2-OH + SOCl2 -> R-CH2-Cl, then R-CH2-Cl + NH3 -> R-CH2-NH2 + HCl.
